svg.aria-label: IT Helpdesk Agent architecture as built
svg.text: Scenario 2 · The IT Helpdesk Agent: the architecture as built
Offline we build the index. Online, code routes and enforces the guardrails, the LLM only writes text, and a ticket exists only after Approve.
You build · ingestion (offline, run by hand)
openai/gpt-4.1-mini · temperature 0 · text only, no tools
per-session lock (one turn at a time)
injection text withheld from later turns
incident · status · preference · clarify · resolved (triage straight to respond)
Guardrails in code (functions inside the nodes, not nodes)
refusals: SP-001/002 · Finance + Contractor VPN · access rules · filter_evidence drops forbidden chunks
coverage partial/unavailable: fixed "could not be verified" reply, no LLM · department unknown: asks for email
incident shortcut is skipped when a Finance, Contractor or security rule applies
6 tools registered · 4 called by the app:
(not on the client allow-list, so refused)
create ticket (422 on bad fields) · idempotency key
state IN MEMORY: its tickets vanish on restart
Limits: helpdesk API tickets vanish when it restarts;
tickets.db keeps them, but never updates their status.
The password protects the Gradio page only:
/api/session/start takes a directory email, no password.
Docker covers the simulator only; no cloud deployment.
Human in the loop · outside the graph: every step below is FastAPI code, reached only after the turn ends
the only ticket writer in the app
